channel.title: Mara Ellison — Blog
channel.description: Long-form articles on WebGL, web performance, motion design, accessibility and the web platform by creative frontend developer Mara Ellison.

item.title: Building Buttery WebGL Page Transitions with Three.js
item.description: A step-by-step guide to shader-based image transitions in Three.js — texture loading, a displacement shader, GSAP timing and graceful fallbacks.
item.author: hello@maraellison.dev (Mara Ellison)

item.title: Core Web Vitals for Creative Websites: A Practical Playbook
item.description: How to keep LCP, INP and CLS green on sites full of WebGL, video and animation — with budgets, lazy loading and real-user measurements.
item.author: hello@maraellison.dev (Mara Ellison)

item.title: Designing a Motion System: Principles for Meaningful UI Animation
item.description: Tokens for duration and easing, choreography rules and reduced-motion fallbacks — how to turn one-off animations into a coherent motion system.
item.author: hello@maraellison.dev (Mara Ellison)

item.title: Astro or Next.js? Choosing a Stack for Content-Heavy Sites
item.description: Why this portfolio uses Next.js for the interactive homepage and Astro for the blog — and a checklist for deciding on your own project.
item.author: hello@maraellison.dev (Mara Ellison)

item.title: Generative Music in the Browser with the Web Audio API
item.description: Build a tiny lo-fi generator with oscillators, filters, a lookahead scheduler and a convolution reverb — the same engine behind this site's music player.
item.author: hello@maraellison.dev (Mara Ellison)

item.title: JSON-LD Recipes: Structured Data That Actually Ships
item.description: Copy-paste JSON-LD for Person, FAQ, Product, Review, Event and Breadcrumb markup — plus how to test it before search engines do.
item.author: hello@maraellison.dev (Mara Ellison)

item.title: Accessible Custom Cursors and Pointer Effects
item.description: Custom cursors and mouse trails can delight — or exclude. How to build them so they respect touch devices, reduced motion and assistive technology.
item.author: hello@maraellison.dev (Mara Ellison)
